routeVersion: The Amtrak Routes dataset updated May 12, 2026 from the Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) and is part of the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). This dataset is a single line representation of unique routes that are generated from the North American Railroad Network (Amtrak). It contains a geographic reference of the Amtrak system at 1:24,000 or better and the dataset covers all 50 states and the District of Columbia. A data dictionary, or other source of attribute information, is accessible at https://doi.org/10.21949/1529009
stationVersion: The Amtrak Stations dataset is as of October 08, 2026 from Amtrak and is part of the U.S. Department of Transportation (USDOT)/Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS) National Transportation Atlas Database (NTAD). This dataset contains Amtrak intercity railroad and bus passenger terminals in the United States. A data dictionary, or other source of attribute information, is accessible at https://doi.org/10.21949/1529010

preprocessing: Select explicitly audited route OBJECTIDs; project every source vertex with the same state-boundary fit; merge all parts into one track graph (identical source vertices are junctions; part ends within 0.15 SVG units are joined, Boston North/South stay separate); for each OneLine network edge keep only the shortest source track between the two cities' Amtrak stations, so no track beyond our cities is drawn; simplify each kept path with Douglas-Peucker tolerance 0.12 SVG units; round to 0.01 SVG units. No new track geometry. Stony Brook is a single LIRR station marker from cited coordinates; its link to New York is rendered as a dashed schematic, not track.
